About the job

Description

What We’re Looking For:

The Product Marketing Specialist - Market & Competitive Intelligence role is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing, global company as an individual contributor with potential for people management in the future.

This role supports Meltwater’s Product Marketing team by delivering competitive intelligence, market insights, and messaging that strengthen product positioning and sales effectiveness. The position monitors market and competitor activity, develops competitive assets, and helps translate insights into product messaging and enablement materials for internal teams. Working cross-functionally with product, sales, marketing, and analyst relations, the role helps ensure teams are equipped with the insights and materials needed to effectively communicate Meltwater’s value in the market.

What You'll Do:


Competitive monitoring: Track top-tier and trade news impacting Meltwater, key competitors, and the broader market, and communicate through Slack, email, and monthly newsletters. 
Competitive Intelligence Assets: Develop and maintain competitive assets—including battle cards, research briefs, and presentations and support sales and product team requests for competitive insights. 
Analyst Relations: Support M&CI Manager with regular briefings and inquiries with industry analysts and assist with analyst research evaluations as needed. 
Product Messaging & Positioning: Incorporate competitive insights into product messaging and communicate product updates that clearly articulate customer value. 
Sales Enablement: Manage and maintain sales and marketing assets that support revenue generation across prospects and existing customers. 
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with the global Product Marketing team and stakeholders across product, sales, customer success, UX, partnerships, marketing, and engineering to ensure alignment. 


What You'll Bring:


Experience: 2-5 years of Product Marketing experience, ideally within a SaaS environment or an agency setting. Preference given to those with an understanding of general Product Marketing pillars of work, including: GTM, Messaging, Sales Enablement, Market & Competitive Intelligence, and Analyst Relations. Experience in public relations, communications, or analyst relations is a plus, but not required. 
Education: A bachelor's degree is required, and in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is a plus.

Deep understanding of the SaaS industry, market trends, and customer needs. 
Understanding of trends and technologies shaping the Marketing, PR, Communications, and Social Media landscapes. 
Familiarity with key industry focus areas, including Social Listening & Monitoring, Influencer Marketing & Campaign Measurement, Media Intelligence, Consumer Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and its application in Public Relations and Marketing. 
Experience with tools such as SalesHood, Gong, ChatGPT, Claude, Pendo, Intercom, ProductBoard, Salesforce, Totango, Asana, Marketo, Wistia, Loom, Miro, Frame.io, and Camtasia is advantageous.

Organizational skills to manage multiple projects and deliverables. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Complimentary CalmApp subscription for you and your loved ones because mental wellness matters.

- Excellent written English.

- Occasional Shopify and Recharge support.

- Campaigns are launched accurately and on schedule.

Standard operating procedures (SOP), Quality assurance (QA), Klaviyo, Graphic design, Figma, Email marketing, Content generation, Shopify, HTML, Copywriting

Haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte a equilibrar exitosamente tu vida laboral y personal. Como negocio en crecimiento, fomentaremos que desarrolles tanto tus aspiraciones profesionales como personales, disfrutes de nuevas experiencias y aprendas de las personas talentosas con las que trabajarás. La descripción del puesto anterior ha sido diseñada para indicar la naturaleza general y el nivel del trabajo realizado por los empleados dentro de esta clasificación. No está destinada a contener ni a interpretarse como un inventario exhaustivo de todas las funciones, responsabilidades y cualificaciones requeridas para los empleados asignados a este puesto.

Las políticas de contratación de Ticketmaster están diseñadas para incorporar a las personas más calificadas disponibles de manera oportuna y eficiente. Ticketmaster puede utilizar todos los medios disponibles, incluyendo la promoción interna, referencias de empleados, publicidad externa, agencias de empleo, reclutamiento por internet, ferias de empleo, reclutamiento universitario y head hunters. About the job

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Our Empowerment Operations team is looking for a high-performing intern to support one of the most impactful and fast-paced operational strategies in the region. This role is focused on optimizing and scaling key processes that directly support our couriers and shoppers within the DiDi Shop groceries ecosystem across Spanish-speaking Latin America.

You will work closely with experienced operations leaders to ensure efficient execution of prepaid card distribution, delivery of essential supplies, and cross-country coordination of our shopper strategy.

In this role, you'll be...


Supporting the end-to-end operational strategy for couriers, including the distribution and activation of prepaid cards and delivery supplies critical for grocery order fulfillment.
Monitoring and optimizing logistics flows for shoppers and couriers across multiple cities and countries.
Collaborating in the design and implementation of regional strategies to improve efficiency and reliability in last-mile operations.
Leading and supporting data coordination efforts to ensure accurate tracking of prepaid card status, inventory of supplies, and shopper coverage.

Generating data-driven insights to improve execution speed, reduce inefficiencies, and scale our operational capabilities.
Participating in the design and rollout of new initiatives to empower our field teams with the right tools, training, and support to succeed.
Ensuring swift execution with attention to detail, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Enrollment in a bachelor's degree, such as Engineering, Business, or related fields.
Passionate or strongly interested in the Technology.
Analytical and structured with good problem-solving skills.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Collaborative team player with a positive attitude.
Willing to learn and develop his/her skillset; Self-motivated, proactive, with a can-do nature.
High proficiency in both Spanish and English is essential 
Great knowledge of Microsoft Office tools - particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Programming language skills (Python, SQL, or R) are highly appreciated but not required
Availability to work at least 6 hours per day or equivalent to 30 hours per week.
Availability for at least 12 months of contract 



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

About the job

Nota: este trabajo requiere experiencia profesional en actuación de voz, además de una configuración y equipo de grabación profesional.




Acerca de Babel Audio: Babel Audio se asocia con las principales empresas tecnológicas para recopilar datos de voz de alta calidad que entrenan modelos de IA de vanguardia. Trabajamos con miles de participantes en todo el mundo para capturar conversaciones humanas auténticas, con el fin de que la IA pueda comprender y comunicarse con las personas de manera más efectiva.




Acerca del puesto: Babel Audio busca actores y actrices de voz hispanohablantes con experiencia profesional para un proyecto de interpretación en solitario. Tus actuaciones se utilizarán para entrenar sistemas de IA en la comprensión y expresión de emociones humanas. Es un trabajo interpretativo y orientado al personaje que requiere verdadero oficio, y hemos estructurado este proyecto para reflejarlo.




Recibirás un guión y un resumen de escena, estudiarás el contexto emocional y darás vida a una interpretación fiel al personaje y al momento. Las escenas son específicas y emocionalmente ricas. Podrías interpretar a:

Una novia que se despide de su familia con el corazón lleno de emoción
Un padre que sostiene a su recién nacido por primera vez, desbordado de sentimiento
Un pastor que divisa un lobo a lo lejos y se pone en alerta para proteger su rebaño
Un médico que, con el corazón encogido, debe comunicar el fallecimiento de un paciente a su familia
Un corredor que, tras años de entrenamiento, se acerca a la meta completamente emocionado




Las grabaciones duran menos de un minuto. Tú decides qué guiones tomar y trabajas completamente según tu propio horario.




Quién eres

Fluidez para hablar español con nivel nativo
Experiencia profesional en actuación de voz, doblaje, narración, grabación de audiolibros o similar
Capacidad para ofrecer interpretaciones vocales expresivas y envolventes en distintos estilos y registros emocionales
Comodidad para interpretar un resumen de escena y trabajar de forma independiente con mínima dirección




Compensación

$120 USD por hora grabada
Pueden estar disponibles incentivos adicionales por desempeño




Requisitos técnicos

Micrófono externo; se recomienda firmemente el uso de filtro antipop o pantalla antiviento
Entorno de grabación tranquilo y con control acústico, sin ruido de fondo
Conexión a internet estable que permita grabaciones de audio sin interrupciones




La tarifa corresponde al tiempo de audio grabado para este proyecto específico. Las solicitudes también podrán ser consideradas para otros proyectos de Babel Audio, que pueden tener tarifas distintas. Consulta nuestros Términos de Uso y Política de Privacidad para más información.




Las tarifas de compensación varían según el país de residencia. Las tarifas aplicables se comunicarán en el panel de control de Babel Audio al momento de realizar la oferta.




—




About Babel Audio: Babel Audio partners with leading technology companies to collect high-quality voice data that trains frontier AI models. We work with thousands of participants worldwide to capture authentic human conversation, so that AI can better understand and communicate with humanity.




About the Role: Babel Audio is seeking professional Spanish-speaking voice actors for a solo performance project. Your performances will be used to train AI systems to better understand and express human emotion. This is interpretive, character-driven work that requires genuine craft, and we have structured this engagement to reflect that.




You will receive a script and scene brief, study the emotional context, and deliver a performance that is true to the character and moment. The scenes are specific and emotionally rich. You might perform as:

A bride, bidding farewell to her family, overwhelmed with emotion
A father, holding his newborn child for the first time, overcome with feeling
A shepherd, spotting a wolf in the distance, becoming alert to protect his herd
A doctor, with a heavy heart, delivering the news of a patient's passing to their family
A runner, after years of training, nearing the finish line and filled with emotion




Recordings are under one minute. You select which scripts to take on, and you work entirely on your own schedule.

Native-level fluency in Spanish

Comfortable interpreting a scene brief and working independently with minimal direction

About the job

SW Developer (Intern) - Retail Software 

We are looking for University/college students ready to assist, receive guidance, and learn from more experienced/senior SW Engineers. We are looking for someone at least one year from graduation and prepared to take on challenging support/development activities. As an SW Dev Intern working for Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions, you will play a key role in supporting some of the essential SW ingredients used in several of the most important retail brands. We provide services to retail clients worldwide by developing and delivering a wide variety of custom software solutions such as POS, self-checkout, and mobility solutions. We seek proactive and skilled resources to work in a dynamic, collaborative, and ever-changing environment.

Responsibilities will include working in cross-functional teams to define SW requirements, analyzing/providing schedule input, writing functional and design specifications, developing application software in an agile framework, supporting software test efforts, and participating in support of the software once in production. As part of this role, you will also learn and aid in DevOps, vulnerability analysis, and agile deployments.

Candidate Profile Required


A student with at least one year from graduation (Computer Science, SW Engineering, Electronics Eng.)
Knowledge in Object-oriented programming (Java) 
Knowledge with JavaScript
Basic understanding of Extensible Markup Language (XML)
Basic understanding/expertise in WEB development
English: Fluent.
The candidate needs strong programming and analytical skills, problem determination and debugging knowledge, attention to detail, teamwork, and excellent communication skills. 


The candidate will have additional advantages if they have some experience with Jenkins, GIT, Docker, JUNIT, DevOps, Scrum, or prior retail SW Dev or testing experience.

About The Company

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands. Have you ever been in a hurry and made use of the self-checkout at Lowe's Foods, earned fuel rewards at Kroger, or just paid for purchases at retailers such as Walmart, Michaels, Carrefour, The Gap, Calvin Klein, Boots, Cencosud, BJ's, or Costco? These are just a few examples of our in-store solutions and impressive customer base that made us the world's installed market share leader.

The nature of retail is changing quickly, so if you share our 'Together Commerce' vision of a seamless two-way, participatory shopping experience, let's get together to drive the new economy.

Permanente

 Coordinar prioridades de campañas según momentos comerciales y necesidades del negocio.

Indispensables

 Calidad de ejecución y gestión de agencias


¿Qué encontrarás aquí?

Somos más que un lugar de trabajo: construimos y vivimos diariamente el Ecosistema Bien Estar Bien, basado en la relación armoniosa entre cada individuo, las relaciones a su alrededor y el entorno en el que está inmerso. Además de ofrecer beneficios enfocados en el bienestar social, físico, financiero, mental y emocional, promovemos un ambiente de prosperidad, pertenencia y propósito, fortaleciendo una red sólida de apoyo, expansión de la conciencia y respeto por la diversidad, equidad e inclusión.

Somos un movimiento que transforma la forma de vivir y hacer negocios en 14 países de América Latina, siempre guiados por la conciencia.

Natura celebra y abraza la diversidad en todas sus formas y pluralidades.

description:
About the job

Description

At Amazon, we are constantly pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We believe that every day is an opportunity to take a first step, tackle new challenges, and make our customers’ lives easier. And today, that opportunity is yours!

As a Learning Manager at Amazon, you will play a vital role in developing and managing a team of trainers responsible for delivering high-quality learning experiences to our associates and managers. Working closely with Process Engineers, you will collaborate with Operations teams to ensure our training programs meet customer needs and align with our mission to be Earth’s most customer-centric company.

You will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and challenging environment, with many opportunities to make an impact. Whether you are developing training plans, auditing training quality, or planning and executing the recruitment of new instructors, you will be at the forefront of shaping the future of our organization.

To get an idea of what it is like to work in an Amazon Fulfillment Center, watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cozvNg-a5EI

Key job responsibilities


 Develop training plans that minimize operational disruption while ensuring high-quality learning delivery.
 Audit training and coaching quality and implement corrective actions when necessary.
 Plan and execute the recruitment, selection, and development of top-performing trainers.
 Foster positive and effective collaboration between the Learning team and key stakeholders.
 Manage a team of Trainers and support their professional growth and development.
 Analyze and interpret metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
 Deliver training to the Learning team regarding updates to learning materials and processes.
 Develop training capacity plans and forecasting for new hires.
 Support leadership teams by providing reports related to Associate (AA) allocation based on training status and cross-training plans across processes.
 Experience designing and implementing training strategies, policies, and procedures to standardize and deliver training methodologies across an organization.
 Experience managing training KPIs and planning and coordinating training programs for more than 1,000 employees.
 Experience interacting with Learning Management Systems (LMS).


About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or related field experience
 Experience collaborating with global and local stakeholders
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent


Preferred Qualifications


 2+ years of relevant field experience


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

 As a Customer Success Sr. Specialist for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. About the job

About Zegna

The global leader in luxury menswear, ZEGNA was founded in the Italian Alps in 1910. Part of the Ermenegildo Zegna Group, the brand remains true to the values of its visionary Founder, Ermenegildo Zegna, who believed in creating world-class fabrics in harmony with both nature and local communities—a philosophy embodied by Oasi Zegna, the home of our values. The inspiration behind the brand’s values, Oasi Zegna, continues to guide everything we do at ZEGNA — from supporting our people to fostering a culture of growth, where craftsmanship and innovation are core elements of our learning processes and long-term growth strategy.

YOUR ROLE AT ZEGNA

As Visual Merchandiser LATAM, based in Polanco, Mexico City, you will bring your unique strengths to the LATAM Visual Merchandising Department, helping us elevate the customer experience and support business performance across the region. Using your creativity, commercial sensibility, guest understanding, and passion for product, you will transform stores and windows into stages that celebrate ZEGNA’s creative direction and brand DNA, while ensuring alignment with global visual merchandising standards.

How You Bring It To Life

Here’s how you’ll bring this role to life each day — making it your own and shaping it with your unique talents and expertise:


Partner with our Store Planning and Merchandising teams to create and innovate impactful visual displays that inspire and engage customers.

Support the implementation and execution of seasonal visual merchandising guidelines, campaigns, and product presentations across the region.

Source and recommend alternative products and solutions for interior presentations when needed.
Monitor the quality and effectiveness of visual merchandising executions, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.
Stay informed on competitor activities, retail trends, and industry best practices to continuously elevate visual presentation standards.
Support new store openings, renovations, and special projects as required across the LATAM region.
Actively communicate market feedback, visual merchandising insights, and best practices to relevant stakeholders to strengthen the customer experience and support business objectives.
Actively communicate guest insights, product feedback, and key store updates within the team to help ensure guest satisfaction and support business goals.


Who You Are

This is how you show up:


You bring solid experience in retail visual merchandising, with a proven ability to execute and maintain premium brand presentation standards.
You can transform conceptual ideas into practical and impactful visual solutions.
You demonstrate a genuine passion for luxury, product storytelling, and brand excellence, with exceptional attention to detail and a hands-on approach.
You are willing and able to travel across the LATAM region as business needs require.


NATURALLY IN ZEGNA

Joining us means stepping into a world of excellence, where the uniqueness of our authenticity is rooted in the talents of our people, who together contribute to weaving a story of innovation and craftsmanship. You will become part of an ongoing journey of development, uncovering your talents while contributing to a proud legacy and a vibrant tomorrow.

About the job

1.) Introduction

Job Title: Content Creator & Marketing Strategist
Work Hours/Schedule: Full-Time (40 hours/week), Eastern Time (EST/EDT) overlap required
Location: Remote, Latin America




2.) Overview

If you can tell a brand's story through video and back it up with real strategy, this one is for you.

This is a fast-growing, full-service events company based in the Washington DC area that has evolved from its catering roots into a full event coordination business, handling weddings, galas, corporate events, and destination events across the country. The team is scaling quickly and building stronger relationships with high-value clients, including corporate and government accounts, so long-term brand presence matters more than ever. The owner is hands-on and deeply involved in the brand's identity, and is looking for someone who can elevate how the company shows up online, not just maintain it.

This isn't a role where you wait for direction. You'll be trusted to develop the marketing strategy, shoot and edit the video content that brings it to life, and manage the social presence that turns followers into leads. If you love owning both the big picture and the hands-on execution, this is a seat built for you.




3.) Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute marketing strategies and campaigns that align with company goals, identifying target segments such as high-value clients, corporate events, and government officials
Manage and optimize Instagram, LinkedIn, and other social platforms, curating portfolio style content that showcases weddings, galas, and corporate events
Edit and produce high-quality video content from raw footage, including promotional videos, event highlights, and behind-the-scenes footage, optimized for YouTube, Instagram, and other platforms
Plan content calendars, posting schedules, and manage SEO optimization for video content
Coordinate with internal departments to execute marketing initiatives, develop promotional materials, and set direction for the internal team's content needs
Plan and execute marketing campaigns for events and services, tracking performance and ROI
Work directly with the owner to understand business goals, proactively bringing recommendations and solutions rather than waiting for direction
Reach out to micro-influencers and brand ambassadors to build collaborations that align with the brand




4.) Must-Have Requirements

5+ years of marketing experience with a proven track record of campaign success
Strong focus on YouTube video creation and editing, with real production chops, not just scheduling
Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, or equivalent
Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to propose marketing initiatives and solutions rather than just execute
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Experience with social media marketing and content strategy
A portfolio or examples of previous marketing work and video editing projects
Ability to work independently and take ownership of marketing initiatives
Understanding of B2C marketing and brand positioning
Reliable internet connection and a dedicated remote workspace
Ability to generate leads through content and social channels




5.) Nice-to-Have Requirements

Experience in events, hospitality, or the luxury service industry
Graphic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite)
Experience with SEO optimization
Knowledge of Meta ads and LinkedIn advertising
YouTube channel management experience
Experience with email marketing platforms
Bilingual capabilities
Experience with CRM systems
An existing internet presence or personal channels
Experience with WeddingPro




6.) Why Join Us

This is a real seat at the table for someone who wants to shape a brand's entire online presence, not just post to a calendar someone else built. You'll work directly with an owner who is fully invested in getting this right and who wants your ideas, not just your execution. If you're the kind of person who sees a messy Instagram grid and immediately knows how to fix it, or who can turn raw event footage into something that actually converts, this is where that skill gets recognized and rewarded. There's real room to grow here as the company scales, and real ownership over the creative direction from day one.

Your role at Clorox:

At Clorox, the Master Data Analyst plays a critical role at the heart of our supply chain and product lifecycle. This position sits on the front lines of product lifecycle management, master data governance, and materials management, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the data that fuels our operations and financial results.

As a Master Data Analyst, you will gain a broad, end-to-end view of the supply chain, from ideation and product creation to production and delivery to our customers. You will work cross-functionally with Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Finance, Customer Service, and Brand teams, acting as a key steward of Clorox’s data and materials across systems.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, managing complexity, and making a tangible impact on how products are launched, maintained, and retired.

The role is based in our facilities located in Jinetes, Mexico City, with a hybrid working model -3 days at the office, 2 working from home each week.

In this role, you will:

Manage New Item / System Set-up


Responsibility for attending scoping calls and coordinating set-up activities for all assigned projects and materials.

Understand network supply chain for set-up.
Coordinate and effectively prioritize workstreams for all project materials—raw materials, packaging, work-in-progress ‘WIPs’ and finished goods.

Data Maintenance

Maintain positive relations with plants/external manufacturers and brand stakeholders.


Reporting


Research inventory and collaborate with Supply Planners, Plants, Vendors, and Copackers
Complete quarterly miscellaneous to determine if Finance should reserve inventory.
